facts.fact: At first light Neela returned the eleven Resin House pages to their owners in the open sun.

The queen reclaims the loan on Chathu's forty pages: she will have them back in her case by dusk, and while they lie there any hand she trusts can read the eleven unnamed pages at night. Kamalakshi's is among the eleven.
Thankam says Devan's right hand will not close hard again; he can lift a cup in time but cannot kill with it. His marma strike is gone.
Usha writes her full name Ushakumari on the roll; Kandan adds his village Mathoor. The roll reaches sixty names and the plank holds forty-one with nine late fills.
Janu lights a sesame-oil lamp at noon on the bottom step of the west stair and will light it every noon she is in the house.
